title: NATS JetStream is the producer-consumer bus, gRPC is the control plane, and status codes drive routing: every component is a black box behind a subject
text: Owner, chat 2026-10-10 ~20:05 UTC: 'NATS JetStream for producer consumer model on gRPC, be smart'; 'that is really how we black box shit'; 'drive the system by status codes, so easy'. Design: records and queue entries are JetStream messages on subjects factory.<kind>.<priority>, each carrying the STC-http-shaped status code; durable pull consumers per seat role, explicit ack, nak with AckWait replaces the lease TTL for queue work, max deliver then a dead-letter subject the monitor records as 500. gRPC (protos under factory/proto/) is the synchronous control plane only: orchestrator, monitor, seat bring-up and health; nothing asynchronous rides gRPC streaming. routes.json (SCH-routes) matches on the code in the message, so adding behaviour is a table row and a consumer, never a change inside another component: that is the black box. The file queue in SPEC-03 s-locks stays only as the offline fallback. Ticket WO-20261010-539f amends SPEC-03 and stands up the bus.
